result.instructions: Tools for Accelevents, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many attendees have checked in to our summit so far?"; "List the sessions in the main track for next week's event."; "Which speakers have no session assigned yet?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Accelevents data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run accelevents_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run accelevents_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run accelevents_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. accelevents_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: accelevents_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees
tools.description: List the attendees of an event with ticket status, ticket type and check-in data, paged and searchable. Personal data: names and emails. Accelevents API: GET /rest/events/{eventurl}/staff/allAttendees.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

search.description: Free-text search over the returned records.

ticket_status.description: Filter by ticket status, as the Accelevents API names it.

ticket_type_ids.description: Comma-separated ticket type ids to filter by.

recurring_event_id.description: Recurring event id, when the event repeats.

tools.name: accelevents_get_ticket_sales
tools.title: Get ticket sales
tools.description: Get the ticket sales data shown on the event dashboard (by default ticket types; ADDON details when asked). Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/performance/ticketing/sale.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

data_type.description: Data type to return. Default is ticket details; send 'ADDON' for add-ons.

recurring_event_id.description: Recurring event id, when the event repeats.

tools.name: accelevents_check_recurring_event
tools.title: Check recurring event
tools.description: Check whether the event is a recurring event. Returns true or false. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/ticketing/checkRecurring.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

tools.name: accelevents_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: List the sessions of an event (title, time, speakers, tracks, tags), paged and searchable. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/session.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

event_id.description: Numeric event id from Accelevents. Required by this route.

search.description: Free-text search over the returned records.

expand.description: Comma-separated related objects to include, for example TAG,TRACK,SPEAKER.

tools.name: accelevents_list_public_sessions
tools.title: List public sessions
tools.description: List the sessions shown on the public display and portal pages, filtered by tag, track or format. Upcoming sessions by default. Accelevents API: GET /rest/events/{eventurl}/session/v2/get-all-sessions.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

search.description: Free-text search over the returned records.

session_format.description: Session format filter, as the Accelevents API names it.

past.description: true returns past sessions instead of upcoming ones.

tools.name: accelevents_get_attendee_sessions
tools.title: Get an attendee's sessions
tools.description: Get all sessions one attendee can see for the event, by the attendee's user id. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/attendee/user/{id}.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

tools.name: accelevents_list_speakers
tools.title: List speakers
tools.description: List the speakers of an event (name, title, email, sessions), paged and searchable. Personal data: emails. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/speaker.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

event_id.description: Numeric event id from Accelevents. Required by this route.

search.description: Free-text search over the returned records.

expand.description: Comma-separated related objects to include, for example SESSION.

tools.name: accelevents_create_speaker
tools.title: Create a speaker
tools.description: Create a speaker on the event. Adds a record that appears in the event's speaker list. Accelevents API: POST /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/speaker.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

title.description: Job title shown on the speaker profile.

tools.name: accelevents_remove_session_bookmark
tools.title: Remove a session bookmark
tools.description: Unregister an attendee from a session, or remove the session from the attendee's bookmarks. Needs the session id and the attendee user id. Accelevents API: DELETE /rest/events/{eventurl}/user-session/register/event-ticket/{id}.

event_url.description: Event URL slug, for example 'my-summit-2027'. Default: the event from your login.

event_ticket_id.description: Registered event ticket id: the {id} in the Accelevents path.
